name: Akemine Suzuri
source:
Likes: Cute things, her mother
Dislikes: Bullying

Despite her brash and rough outlook, Suzuri is a kind girl who helps people no matter where she goes, whether it be helping an old lady cross the road or taking care of an injured cat. She also has a surprisingly girly side to her.
